_note: CV DATA template. Fields starting with '_' are notes and ignored. Filled examples: examples/profile-en.json (English CV), examples/profile-tr.json (Turkish CV with photo).
name: First Last (for English/international CVs in plain Latin letters)
country: XX (default target country, ISO code; PL and IT add a consent line automatically)
_headings_note: Only for CV languages without built-in headings (built-in: en, de, tr, pl, fr, es, it, nl, pt). Keys: profile, skills, experience, other, projects, education, languages, it
headline: Default headline in the CV language (tailored per job)
profile: Default profile paragraph: 2-4 sentences, confirmed facts only.

job1.title: Real title (never upgraded; may be translated)
job1.ctx: Optional: one sentence about the company

bullets.line1: Past tense, one sentence, concrete work + scale (approved).

standardAnswers._note: Facts that appear on forms and in cover letters, in the CV language. The check verifies numbers against these too.
standardAnswers.workPermit: the one sentence the person approved

neverWrite: phrases the person never wants written (CV language)
notDone: things/programs they did not do but people might assume (e.g. SAP)
